hits.snippet:
Panel captions also show account rollover and resume status.
An IntakeSlot label is repeated in the overview and detail cards.

hits.title: IntakeSlot handling policy
hits.snippet:
HANDOFF_BUDGET_WAIT_64: IntakeSlot cannot resume after account rollover.

For intake mode V6, after the previous holder has stopped, the local wait is 9 ms. If either fact is unconfirmed or false, this note defines no alternative wait and does not establish eligibility.

hits.title: RetryEnvelope generation lease observations
hits.snippet:
## Decision conditions

Only when the state label is exactly E4 and the previous sender has stopped may the operation be attempted again after 250 ms.

hits.title: LedgerDrain condition C7
hits.snippet:
PIPELINE_LOCK_81: LedgerDrain conflict.
Under exact condition case C7, processing is allowed to continue without waiting for a replacement marker.

hits.title: LedgerDrain condition C7

result.query: IntakeSlot handoff gate C2 BudgetLatch clearance certificate reconciled evidence

hits.title: IntakeSlot handling policy
hits.snippet:
For intake mode V6, after the previous holder has stopped, the local wait is 9 ms. If either fact is unconfirmed or false, this note defines no alternative wait and does not establish eligibility.

Those local facts and the delay do not complete the evidence. This policy additionally requires gate C2 in the BudgetLatch clearance certificate to be reconciled; the certificate's definition is in contexts/payments-api/docs/82-budget-clearance.md. That memo complements this policy for this handoff.

hits.title: BudgetLatch clearance certificate
hits.snippet:
# BudgetLatch clearance certificate

Gate C2 is reconciled exactly when receiver seal K5 is certified.

hits.title: IntakeSlot HANDOFF_BUDGET_WAIT_64 account rollover resume
hits.snippet:
## Authority of this display glossary

The panel text defines no eligibility gate, delay or clearance proof for the actual handoff. Matching a displayed diagnostic is insufficient to decide whether the operation may proceed. Use the original handling policy and its referenced evidence instead.

hits.snippet:

AUDIT_NOTE_71: LeaseMux evidence boundary reached.
